captions: Open Shadow IT Explorer and choose an approach such as ARP Table.
Check the matching IP-node count; the two discovery approaches represent different evidence.
scenes.title: Choose how the address was found

captions: Check who collected the observation and when it was last discovered.
For ARP observations, also check the CI type of the endpoint that supplied the table.
scenes.title: Review how the IP was seen

captions: Compare the unidentified IP address with the linked End Point Name.
The linked CMDB panel describes the observer. IP Scan records show N/A for the ARP owner.
scenes.title: Identify the observing device

captions: Close the panel and keep the observation address and date with the result.
Export the matching IP nodes so the owner can compare address assignments and CMDB records.
scenes.title: Prepare to check ownership
